items.text: Cobalt moves to a new core banking system Saturday, December 12, 00:00 to Sunday, December 13, 12:00 (Central Time).
A payment processor used by many online stores reported a data breach. Some Cobalt cards may be affected. The number of cards is not yet known.
After an app update, some Cobalt customers cannot log in or see their transactions. Cobalt says it is working on a fix; when it will be fixed is not known.
